# Data Source: catalyst_project_environments

List existing environments and their reported status using the Catalyst CLI's environment lookup. The official CLI uses `ZohoCatalyst.projects.ALL` for this lookup. Environment activation and promotion are separate workflows. Verified offline.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_project_environments" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
}

output "project_environments" {
  value = data.catalyst_project_environments.existing.environments
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `environments` (Attributes List) Existing environments sorted lexicographically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Environment ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether Catalyst reports this environment as the default, when available.
- `name` (String) Environment name reported by Catalyst.
- `status` (String) Raw status, when reported.
- `type` (Number) Numeric environment type, when reported.
